diagnosis: The diagnostic endpoint uses the connect-redis session store to fetch and return arbitrary session payloads by sessionId without verifying administrative roles or tenant boundaries. An attacker who obtains or predicts another user's session identifier can extract the full session object, including OAuth access tokens, user identifiers, and elevated privilege flags.
exploit_request:
GET /api/admin/sessions/sess_usr_prod_99218410/inspect HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.enterprise.internal:3001
Authorization: Bearer <unprivileged_jwt>
Accept: application/json
